purpose: Verified contract for safe citizen-controlled presentation depth over an approved property answer.
view_rule: View mode changes presentation depth only; it does not change the underlying investigation or answer.
scope_rule: Property, date, legal issue, evidence requirements and requested outcome remain fixed unless a separate scope change is authorised.
limitation_rule: Material limitations remain visible in every view.
privacy_rule: Broader views remain subject to public/private and restricted-evidence boundaries.
history_rule: Relevant History contains only approved material history within the established scope.
evidence_rule: Evidence and Law exposes already-approved provenance and legal material; it does not create new analysis.
scope_change_rule: A request outside approved scope is routed as a scope change rather than silently expanded.
verification_boundary: The explorer controls presentation depth and cannot establish new property facts or legal conclusions.
